subject: Solidarity shift proposal: aligning Bloomridge (US) demo with EU engineering windows
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@bloomridge-retail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-11T09:15:00-04:00
Subject: Quick ask — Bloomridge demo windows that work for our ops teams

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. We're excited to see Redwood Inference in action. Our US product and operations teams are spread between EST and CST and we also need input from our NYC-based IT ops folks (they have a maintenance freeze at 10am ET most days).

Short version: we'd like to schedule a 60-minute demo that includes a short Q&A and a walkthrough of your Dedicated/Private deployment options. Our constraints: best window is 8:00–9:30am ET or after 6:30pm ET; mid-day is generally impossible.

I know you've got EU engineers on the deep-dive team, which pushes into late evenings for them. Before we pick a time, can you confirm whether Redwood can (1) send 1 senior infra engineer to the call, and (2) whether you have any flexibility to run demos slightly earlier in the EU day on occasion?

We can do recordings but prefer live for the KV/cache discussion.

Thanks — would love a couple of concrete slots to pick from.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Senior Product Manager — Integrations
Bloomridge Retail

Attachments: none

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@bloomridge-retail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-11T17:30:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — Bloomridge demo windows that work for our ops teams

Hi Sophie — thanks for the details and the timing window.

Short answer: yes, we can commit a senior infra engineer for the technical deep-dive. Long answer: our EU engineering group typically works CET/CEST hours, so early-evening US times can be late-night for them. That said, we've piloted a "solidarity shift" approach for a few strategic customers where a small rotation of engineers starts ~2 hours earlier once or twice a month specifically to cover US mornings without asking the customer to move.

I'm proposing two alternatives to keep this low-friction for Bloomridge and for our engineers:

1) Standard overlap: 8:00am ET / 14:00 CEST — 60-minute live demo with Marcus (infra) and Naomi (solutions). We can do this three times in a row if you want multiple stakeholders to attend.

2) Solidarity shift trial: for this pilot we shift one EU engineer to an earlier day shift. That lets us offer 9:00am ET / 15:00 CEST on short notice twice this quarter; we record and provide the recording plus an ops notes doc. This is something we reserve for accounts where the calendar mismatch would otherwise block a conversation.

I attached: proposed_slots.ics (three concrete slot options), demo-agenda.pdf (walkthrough + Q&A structure), and a Miro link snapshot with the topics we'd like to cover (KV cache, routing, SLOs).

Can you confirm: which option you'd prefer and which stakeholders need to attend (product, ops, IT)? Also let me know if the shift trial requires separate paperwork — we can mark it as "one-off accommodation" on the timeline.

Thanks,
Rachel
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +44 7700 900111

Attachments: proposed_slots.ics, demo-agenda.pdf, miro-board-link.txt

Hi Sophie (and Rachel),

Happy to join the demo for the infra deep-dive. A couple of practical notes from my side:

- If we run during the EU early-shift trial, I’ll be on from 07:30 CEST that day; I can cover KV cache behavior under load, quantization trade-offs for throughput, and a brief walkthrough of our routing/fallback config.
- Please add two items to the agenda if possible: (1) a short load profile (tokens/sec) you'd expect in peak shopping periods, and (2) any compliance constraints around data retention for sandboxing.

If Bloomridge is comfortable with a short poll-based schedule, I suggest we lock on either: 2027-08-19 08:30 ET / 14:30 CEST or 2027-08-24 09:00 ET / 15:00 CEST (the latter is the solidarity-shift trial slot). I've added these to proposed_slots.ics.

Cheers,
Marcus
Staff Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
